end.summary:
Practised ordering: cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism.
Used human and plant examples, including muscle, stomach, heart, leaf, root, xylem, and shoot system.
Yash explained that connected parts can affect the whole body using blood vessels, the heart, and blood flow.
The heart-versus-circulatory-system mix-up was corrected later; teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Yash practised ordering levels of organisation and giving examples in humans and plants. They explained the heart and blood-vessel example to show how parts affect the whole, and later corrected the mix-up between an organ and an organ system. At home, ask them to build two five-step chains—one for a human and one for a plant—and name one example at each step.
